gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Groovy has a narrow slit where its c almost shuts, and every stroke carries the same heavy line. Noto Sans Tai Le is a plain sans whose strokes taper off before they touch, so its letters stay open.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Noto Sans Tai Tham reads as a plain sans with chalkboard lowercase pushed up toward the capital line, its curves clearly open. Groovy brings the funk.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Groovy closes its letters up and gives its tails and terminals the full weight of the stems. But the pair's strongest quality is the gap between that chunky heading and Noto Sans Tai Viet, a plain sans with open curves and a tall x-height.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri holds a high-waisted lowercase, each small round letter left generously unclosed. Noto Sans Takri stays quiet while Groovy, loosely tracked and big, earns its keep in short, large lines.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has round forms like open parentheses. Groovy, friendly and funky, sits over that sans-serif with closed shapes and loose spacing, while the body's tall middle band makes each line look stocky.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa gives its round letters a wide, inviting opening, with short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. And that sans-serif would read smoothly paragraph after paragraph, a welcome change from Groovy's funky, closed-up headings.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC reads as a plain sans with big open counters in a, e and s, and curves that open outward. And Groovy's single-width pen line makes a friendly, funky neighbor, closed and playful beside that openness.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads as a sans-serif with a high-set midline. Its counters stay connected to the outside, and Groovy's thread-thin curves make the strongest quality here: friendly display next to steady text.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Groovy's narrow slit, where the c almost closes, is its signature, and the arms and legs hold constant width. And Noto Sans Thaana, a plain sans with wide channels into each counter, gives the page open lowercase forms to rest on.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-thai: Groovy keeps its letters closed and loosely tracked, with a friendly, funky streak. And Noto Sans Thai, a sans-serif with lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads, would carry a long passage with rounded, open, approachable ease.
